phrases.VariableDescription: Notice: This value comes from an environment variable, so the field is disabled. Saving will not change the running value. Change or remove the variable to edit it here.
phrases.VariableDescriptionPlural: Notice: These values come from environment variables, so the field is disabled. Saving will not change the running values. Change or remove the variables to edit them here.
phrases.SavedRestart: Saved. A restart is needed to fully apply.
phrases.RestartPending: A saved change needs a restart to fully apply. Unpackerr re-execs itself automatically once nothing is queued, extracting, or awaiting delete.
phrases.NothingQueued: Nothing in the queue right now.
phrases.ClearHistoryConfirm: This removes finished rows from the history list. Items still extracting or waiting for import stay in the queue. This cannot be undone.
phrases.ForgetImportedConfirm: This item is still waiting for file cleanup. Forgetting it leaves the extracted files on disk.
phrases.YouDoNotHavePermission: You do not have permission to view this section.
phrases.AdminBuiltin: The built-in admin role grants everything and cannot be edited.
phrases.UiPasswordHelp: The browser hashes the new password the same way as login and sends only the digest. The current password is required to change authentication while local password auth is on.
phrases.UiPasswordFilepath: This password is a filepath: reference. Saving a new password or auth type writes the value into the config file instead.
phrases.ReservedUsername: Usernames webauth, noauth, and filepath are reserved, and a username cannot contain a colon.
phrases.FilterHint: Matches path, app, status, and error text.
phrases.URLMustBeginWithHttp: URL must begin with http:// or https://
phrases.URLInvalid: That is not a valid URL.
phrases.APIKeyMustBeCountCharactersOrLonger: API key must be at least {count} characters.
phrases.FixInvalidFields: Fix the invalid fields before saving.
phrases.SlugInvalid: Key must be letters, digits, underscore, or hyphen.
phrases.RoleNameReserved: The built-in admin role cannot be redefined.
phrases.RoleNameDuplicate: That role name is already used.
phrases.LeavePage: Leave this page? Unsaved changes will be lost.
phrases.ConfigDuration: This is a Go duration in the config file or environment, such as 2m or 15s.
phrases.ConfigDurationOff: This is a Go duration in the config file or environment. Off is 0s.
phrases.ConfigDurationUnset: This is a Go duration in the config file or environment. Unset omits the value (or leaves it empty).
phrases.ConfigDurationDisabled: This is a Go duration in the config file or environment. Disabled is -1s.
phrases.ConfigDurationFolderPoll: This is a Go duration in the config file or environment. Off is 0s and uses filesystem events.
phrases.ConfigSize: This is a size string in the config file or environment, such as 20GB. Unlimited is 0.
phrases.TestStarrEnvOwned: Test cannot run when the URL or API key comes from the environment.
phrases.TestHookEnvOwned: Test cannot run when the URL or command comes from the environment.

login.DisabledHint: Password login is turned off. Sign in through the reverse proxy. If the proxy sent you here, none of the groups matched admin or a configured role.

dashboard.Title: Overview
dashboard.intro: Live queue, extract counts, and finished history for this Unpackerr.
dashboard.StarrsHint: Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, and Readarr instances in the config.
dashboard.StarrQueuesHint: Last activity-queue poll per Starr app. Counts below are from retrieved records.
dashboard.StarrQueueTotalHint: Starr queue size. Retrieved is shown when it differs from the reported total.
dashboard.StarrQueueCompleteHint: Items with Status completed, any protocol.
dashboard.StarrQueueMatchHint: Completed items whose protocol is in this app's protocol list. These are what Unpackerr tracks.
dashboard.StarrQueueIssuesHint: Failed or warning items, including tracked-download errors and warnings. One count per item.
dashboard.FoldersHint: Folder watch paths in the config.
dashboard.WaitingHint: Items waiting on Start Delay, plus folder watches that have not settled yet.
dashboard.ExtractedHint: Extracted and waiting for the Starr app to import.
dashboard.ImportedHint: Imported by the Starr app; waiting for Delete Delay.
dashboard.DeletedHint: Imported items whose files have been deleted.
dashboard.FinishedHint: Items completed since Unpackerr started. This total does not reset.
dashboard.WebhooksHint: HTTP webhooks since start: total / failed.
dashboard.CmdhooksHint: Command hooks since start: total / failed.
dashboard.StackFSHint: Folder-watch filesystem events waiting on the main loop. Occupied / capacity.
dashboard.StackXtractrHint: Starr extract callbacks waiting to be processed. Occupied / capacity.
dashboard.StackFolderHint: Folder-watch extract callbacks waiting to be processed. Occupied / capacity.
dashboard.StackHookHint: Webhooks and command hooks waiting to run. Occupied / capacity.
dashboard.StackDelHint: File deletions waiting to run. Occupied / capacity.
dashboard.StackTaskHint: Config changes and queue actions waiting on the main loop. Occupied / capacity.
dashboard.FSNotifyHint: This folder uses filesystem events (inotify and friends).
dashboard.PollingHint: This folder is polled on a timer. Use that when Docker or CIFS cannot deliver filesystem events.

history.Title: History
history.intro: Finished extracts, including retries and items already deleted from disk.

settings.Title: Configuration
settings.Heading: {settings} — {page}

general.label: General
general.intro: Extract, retry, logging, and archive-password settings that apply everywhere.

starrs.label: Starrs
starrs.intro: Sonarr, Radarr, Lidarr, and Readarr instances Unpackerr polls.

hooks.label: Hooks
hooks.intro: HTTP callbacks and local commands when an extract changes status.

webserver.label: Web Server
webserver.intro: Listen address, TLS, and HTTP logs. Listen address and URL base need a restart.

sonarr.label: Sonarr
sonarr.intro: Sonarr instances Unpackerr polls for completed downloads. Compatible apps such as Sportarr and Fightarr belong here; set a name so logs and hooks are not tagged Sonarr.

radarr.label: Radarr
radarr.intro: Radarr instances Unpackerr polls for completed downloads. Whisparr belongs here; set a name so logs and hooks keep that label.

lidarr.label: Lidarr
lidarr.intro: Lidarr instances Unpackerr polls for completed downloads.

readarr.label: Readarr
readarr.intro: Readarr instances Unpackerr polls for completed downloads.

folders.label: Folders
folders.intro: Watch folders that are not a Starr download path. Folder changes always need a restart.

webhooks.label: Webhooks
webhooks.intro: HTTP callbacks when an extract changes status. Point these at Discord, Slack, Notifiarr, or any URL that accepts a POST.

cmdhooks.label: Command Hooks
cmdhooks.intro: Local commands to run when an extract changes status. Same events as webhooks, executed on this host.

settings.KeyLocked: Name of this instance in the config file, like [sonarr.uhd] or [folder.tv]. Locked after the first save.
settings.KeyTooltip: Used to make each instance unique. Not used in logs or anywhere you'll see it. Also the env slug, such as UN_SONARR_uhd_URL. Keys are case-sensitive.

trust.Title: Trust
trust.intro: UI login, API keys, and custom roles. Your IP must be in Upstreams before you switch to header or no authentication, or you can lock yourself out.

system.Title: System
system.intro: This process, the config file path, and a live dump of running values (secrets stripped).

logs.Title: Logs
logs.intro: View, follow, and download Unpackerr log files.
logs.FollowTooltip: Refresh the list. The list-bullets button follows a file while Unpackerr is writing to it.
logs.Name: Name
logs.SelectFile: Select a file to see what's in it.

docs.Title: API documentation
docs.intro: Interactive OpenAPI explorer for the Unpackerr HTTP API.

errors.MaxRatio: Extracted size exceeds maximum compression ratio
errors.ArchiveSymlink: Refusing to extract a symbolic link as an archive
errors.InvalidHead: Archived file contains invalid header file

debug.label: Debug logging
debug.description: Extra log lines while you are setting things up.
debug.tooltip: Turn this on when you add apps or folders so you can see queue and extract activity. Safe to leave on.

quiet.label: Quiet
quiet.tooltip: Use a log file if you enable this, or you will see almost nothing. Typical when Unpackerr starts from systemd.

activity.label: Log activity
activity.description: Print queue counts only when something is happening.
activity.tooltip: Hides the all-zero queue lines so the log stays readable. Pair with a slower log-queues interval if you still want periodic counts.

errorStderr.label: Errors to stderr
errorStderr.description: Send ERROR lines to stderr instead of stdout.
errorStderr.tooltip: Leave this off unless you split logs that way. Quiet mode ignores it.

parallel.label: Concurrent extractions
parallel.description: How many archives to extract at once.
parallel.tooltip: One at a time is the right default. Raise it only if the disks and CPU can take the extra load.

maxRetries.label: Max retries
maxRetries.description: Extra attempts after a failed extract.
maxRetries.tooltip: The first try is not counted here. In the config file, 0 means use the default of 2.

interval.label: Poll interval
interval.description: How often to poll all Starr apps.
interval.tooltip: Unpackerr asks every Starr app for its queue on this interval. Saving it restarts the pollers immediately. A minute or two is typical; the shortest choice is 15 seconds.

startDelay.label: Start delay
startDelay.description: Wait after a download finishes before extracting.
startDelay.tooltip: Starts once the Starr queue shows the download as complete. Raise this if the client is still moving or finalizing files when extracts begin.

retryDelay.label: Retry delay
retryDelay.tooltip: After a failure, Unpackerr waits this long before treating the item as new and trying again.

deleteDelay.label: Delete delay
deleteDelay.description: How long to keep extracted files after import.
deleteDelay.tooltip: Applies to Starr apps. Already-running apps pick this up after a restart. The shortest choice is 1 second.

progress.label: Progress interval
progress.description: How often to print in-progress extract status.
progress.tooltip: These lines only appear while an extract is running. A 0s value in the config file becomes 15 seconds.

logQueues.label: Log queues interval
logQueues.description: How often to print Starr queue counts.
logQueues.tooltip: Off stops those lines. Activity mode still hides all-zero counts when you leave this on.

keepHistory.label: Keep history
keepHistory.description: Finished items kept in the history file.
keepHistory.tooltip: This is unpackerr.history.jsonl, next to the log (or the config file if logs go to stdout). 0 turns history off.

remnantAction.label: Remnant action
remnantAction.description: What to do when a leftover file blocks an extract.
remnantAction.tooltip: Rename moves the leftover aside and retries. Delete removes it and retries. Off leaves it and fails. Applies to Starr apps and to folders with Move back enabled.

logFile.label: Log file
logFile.description: File to write logs to. Empty prints to stdout.
logFile.tooltip: Same messages that normally go to the terminal. macOS and Windows fill in a default path if this is empty. Set log files to keep to 0 if logrotate should own the file.

logFiles.label: Log files to keep
logFiles.description: How many rotated logs to keep.
logFiles.tooltip: 0 turns auto-rotation off so logrotate can own the file. After logrotate renames the live file, send SIGHUP (systemctl reload unpackerr) to reopen it.

logFileMb.label: Log file size (MB)
logFileMb.description: Rotate when the log file reaches this size.
logFileMb.tooltip: Only used while rotation is enabled. 0 in the config file becomes 10 MB.

passwords.label: RAR/7z passwords
passwords.description: Passwords to try on encrypted archives, one per line.
passwords.tooltip: Tried in order until one works. A line filepath:/path/to/passwords.txt reads more passwords from that file.

listenAddr.label: Listen address
listenAddr.description: Address and port for this UI and API.
listenAddr.tooltip: 0.0.0.0 binds every interface. Empty turns the HTTP server off. Needs a restart.

urlbase.label: URL base
urlbase.description: Path prefix when Unpackerr sits behind a reverse proxy.
urlbase.tooltip: Must not contain curly braces. Needs a restart.

metrics.label: Prometheus metrics
metrics.tooltip: Scrapes need an API key with system:metrics:read. Needs a restart.

pprof.label: pprof debug
pprof.tooltip: Leave this off unless you are debugging this process. Needs a restart.

sslCertFile.label: SSL cert file
sslCertFile.tooltip: Set both the certificate and the key to serve TLS. Needs a restart.

sslKeyFile.label: SSL key file
sslKeyFile.tooltip: Set both the certificate and the key to serve TLS. Needs a restart.

logFile.label: HTTP log file
logFile.description: File for HTTP request logs. Empty uses the main log.
logFile.tooltip: Keeps access logs out of the extract log. Rotation matches the settings below.

logFiles.label: Log files to keep
logFiles.description: How many rotated HTTP logs to keep.
logFiles.tooltip: 0 turns auto-rotation off. SIGHUP reopens this file too.

logFileMb.label: Log file size (MB)
logFileMb.description: Rotate when the HTTP log reaches this size.
logFileMb.tooltip: Only used while rotation is enabled.

upstreams.label: Upstreams
upstreams.description: Trusted reverse-proxy IPs or CIDRs, one per line.
upstreams.tooltip: Lets X-Forwarded-For be trusted in HTTP logs. Example: 127.0.0.1/32 or 10.1.2.0/24.

wsOrigins.label: WebSocket origins
wsOrigins.description: Extra Origin hosts allowed to open the live UI socket, one per line.
wsOrigins.tooltip: Empty keeps same-origin, which is what the embedded UI needs. Add a host when the browser is on another origin, for example localhost:5173. Do not use * unless you mean to allow every site.

keyName.label: Name
keyName.description: Label for this key in the UI and logs.
keyName.tooltip: Names must be unique. Used only to identify the key.

key.label: Key
key.description: Secret the client sends as an API key.
key.tooltip: 60–150 characters. Leave blank when saving to keep the existing key of this name. Generate makes a new one.

roleName.label: Role name
roleName.tooltip: The built-in admin role cannot be redefined. Names are case-sensitive.

authType.label: Authentication
authType.description: How the web UI identifies you.
authType.tooltip: Local password stores a username and password on this host. Header and no authentication only succeed when the request comes from an address in Upstreams.

username.label: Username
username.tooltip: Used as the PBKDF2 salt with the password. webauth, noauth, and filepath are reserved. Changing the username requires a new password.

newPassword.label: New password
newPassword.description: Leave blank to keep the current password.
newPassword.tooltip: Hashed in the browser (PBKDF2) before it is sent. At least 8 characters. Required when switching to local password or changing the username.

currentPassword.label: Current password
currentPassword.description: Required to change authentication while local password auth is on.
currentPassword.tooltip: Hashed in the browser the same way as login. The server checks it with the stored hash before applying a new password or auth type.

header.label: Auth header
header.description: Request header the reverse proxy sets to the username. Open the UI through the proxy to see this request's headers.
header.tooltip: Used only for proxy header auth. The list is this request minus common non-auth headers. No-auth can omit a header; a value here is stored as noauth:Header and used as the username when the proxy sends it. Default X-Webauth-User.

roleHeader.label: Role header
roleHeader.description: Optional request header whose value is an Unpackerr role. Shown for proxy header auth. Empty keeps those users as admin. A selected header that is missing, or has no matching role, denies the request.
roleHeader.tooltip: The proxy should send a built-in admin or a custom role name from the list below. Comma, semicolon, pipe, or space separated lists are unioned; extra names (IdP groups) are ignored. A missing header or no matching role is access denied, not admin. Suggested name: X-Webauth-Role.

name.label: Name
name.description: Label used in logs, webhooks, and the dashboard. Optional.
name.tooltip: Empty uses the app name (Sonarr, Radarr, and so on). Set this for a compatible app such as Sportarr so logs and Discord are not tagged with the dialect. Hook exclude matches this name or the app dialect.

url.label: URL
url.description: Base URL of this Starr app.
url.tooltip: Include the scheme, for example http://127.0.0.1:8989. On HTTPS, the lock button requires a valid certificate.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.description: API key from Settings → General in the Starr app.
apiKey.tooltip: 32 or more characters. A filepath:/path value is also accepted. Leave the field unchanged to keep the current key.

path.label: Path
path.description: Folder Unpackerr reads this app's downloads from.
path.tooltip: Fallback if the path Starr reports is missing or not visible to Unpackerr.
path.config: In the config file this is a list named paths.

protocols.label: Protocols
protocols.tooltip: Newer Starr apps report class names instead of torrent or usenet. The choices here write both forms so either app version matches.

timeout.label: Timeout
timeout.description: How long to wait for this app to reply.
timeout.tooltip: Raise this if the Starr API is slow or remote. A 0s value in the config file uses the global timeout.

delete_delay.label: Delete delay
delete_delay.description: How long to keep extracts after this app imports them.
delete_delay.tooltip: Overrides the general delete delay for this instance.

maxBytes.label: Max bytes
maxBytes.description: Stop an extract if uncompressed size exceeds this.
maxBytes.tooltip: Unlimited turns the cap off for this instance. Each app has its own default when the config file leaves this empty.

delete_orig.label: Delete originals
delete_orig.description: Delete the original download folder after import.
delete_orig.tooltip: Useful for Usenet. Leave this off for torrents so seeding keeps working.

syncthing.label: Syncthing
syncthing.description: Wait until Syncthing finishes before extracting.
syncthing.tooltip: Enable this if downloads land through Syncthing and extracts start too early.

split_flac.label: Split FLAC cue sheets
split_flac.tooltip: Lidarr only. When on, FLAC files with an embedded CUE sheet become one file per track.

interval.label: Poll interval
interval.description: How often to scan watch folders for new archives. Disabled uses inotify or fsnotify.
interval.tooltip: Off uses filesystem events (inotify and friends). Enable a poll interval if files never show up in the queue, which is common on Docker and CIFS. Polling increases disk reads and is not recommended when fsnotify works.

buffer.label: Event buffer
buffer.description: How many folder events can queue at once.
buffer.tooltip: Leave this unless you see dropped events in the log.

path.label: Watch path
path.tooltip: This is not a Starr download path. Use it for a client's "move to" folder or any other drop directory.

extract_path.label: Extract path
extract_path.description: Where to write extracted files. Empty extracts in place.
extract_path.tooltip: If this is empty, files go into the watch path (or an _unpackerred folder unless Move back is on).

delete_after.label: Delete after
delete_after.description: How long to keep files after extract.
delete_after.tooltip: Unset leaves them. Deletes also need Delete original archive and/or Delete all files.

delete_original.label: Delete original archive
delete_original.description: Delete the original archive after extract.
delete_original.tooltip: Requires a Delete after delay. Does not delete the extracted files.

delete_files.label: Delete all files
delete_files.description: Delete extracted files after the delay.
delete_files.tooltip: Requires a Delete after delay. Use this when the watch folder should not keep the output.

move_back.label: Move back
move_back.description: Move extracted files back into the watch folder.
move_back.tooltip: Off leaves them in an _unpackerred folder beside the archive. On also classifies leftover files with Remnant action.

extract_isos.label: Extract ISOs
extract_isos.tooltip: Off ignores ISO images. Turn this on only if you really want them unpacked.

disableRecursion.label: Recursion
disableRecursion.description: Extract archives found inside other archives.
disableRecursion.tooltip: On is the usual setting. Off extracts only the outer archive.

allowSymlinks.label: Allow symlinks
allowSymlinks.description: Include symlink-named archives in the first scan.
allowSymlinks.tooltip: The extras pass never follows zip members that are links. This only affects the initial search.

maxNested.label: Max nested
maxNested.description: Cap on nested archives from this folder.
maxNested.tooltip: 0 is unlimited. Counts archives found in this folder's extract output (one extras pass).

extrasMaxDepth.label: Extras max depth
extrasMaxDepth.description: How deep to walk extract output for more archives.
extrasMaxDepth.tooltip: 0 is unlimited. Limits how far the extras pass descends.

maxBytes.label: Max bytes
maxBytes.description: Stop an extract if uncompressed size exceeds this.
maxBytes.tooltip: Unlimited turns the cap off for this folder. Default for folders is unlimited.

maxFiles.label: Max files
maxFiles.description: Stop after this many files, folders, and symlinks.
maxFiles.tooltip: 0 is unlimited. Guards against archive bombs.

maxRatio.label: Max ratio
maxRatio.description: Stop when written bytes exceed this times the archive size.
maxRatio.tooltip: 0 is unlimited. Another archive-bomb guard (bytes written / archive size).

exclude_paths.label: Exclude paths
exclude_paths.description: Paths to ignore under this folder, one per line.
exclude_paths.tooltip: Excluded paths and their children are not watched or extracted. Absolute, or relative to the watch path.

wait_extensions.label: Wait extensions
wait_extensions.description: Stay waiting while a matching file exists.
wait_extensions.tooltip: One suffix per line, with a leading period (.part, .crdownload). Top folder only, subfolders are not scanned. Extraction starts after start delay once those files are gone. Waiting items are rechecked every 5s even without the poller. Enabling folder poller will double-poll the folder and increase disk reads. This is useful when fsnotify is not available, and not recommended when it is.

skip_empty.label: Skip empty folders
skip_empty.description: Do not queue folders that contain no archives.
skip_empty.tooltip: After start delay, archive-free folders leave the waiting state without history or webhooks.

name.label: Name
name.tooltip: If this is empty, webhooks log the URL and command hooks log the first word of the command.

url.label: URL
url.description: URL to POST when an extract changes status.
url.tooltip: Works with Notifiarr, Discord, Slack, Telegram, and any URL that accepts the payload. Built-in templates are picked from the URL unless you force one in the config file.

command.label: Command
command.tooltip: Extract data is passed as environment variables. Try /usr/bin/env (or a script that prints the environment) to see the names.

shell.label: Run in shell
shell.description: Run the command inside a shell.
shell.tooltip: Uses /bin/sh -c on Unix and cmd.exe /c on Windows. Needed if the command is a pipeline or uses shell syntax.

contentType.label: Content type
contentType.description: Content-Type header sent with the webhook.
contentType.tooltip: Leave application/json unless a custom template needs another MIME type.

ignoreSsl.label: Ignore SSL
ignoreSsl.description: Skip TLS certificate checks for this URL.
ignoreSsl.tooltip: Only for hooks on hosts with a bad or private certificate.

timeout.label: Timeout
timeout.description: How long to wait for the hook to finish.
timeout.tooltip: Applies to the HTTP request or to the command, depending on the hook type.

silent.label: Silent
silent.description: Hide successful runs from the logs.
silent.tooltip: Failures still log. Use this to cut noise from a chatty Discord or Slack hook.

nickname.label: Nickname
nickname.description: Bot name for Discord and Slack. Chat ID for Telegram.
nickname.tooltip: Passed into the built-in templates. Telegram needs the chat_id here.

channel.label: Channel
channel.tooltip: Ignored by Discord and Telegram. Custom templates can still use it.

token.label: Token
token.description: Bot token for Discord, Telegram, Slack, and similar templates.
token.tooltip: Passed into webhook templates. Leave empty unless the template needs it.

exclude.label: Exclude apps
exclude.description: Do not fire this hook for these apps or named instances.
exclude.tooltip: Checking Sonarr skips every Sonarr-style instance, including named ones. Checking only a name skips that instance. Folder means watch-folder extracts.

template.label: Template
template.description: Built-in template. Empty picks one from the URL.
template.tooltip: Force notifiarr, discord, telegram, gotify, pushover, or slack. Leave automatic unless the URL is not recognized.

templatePath.label: Template file
templatePath.description: Custom Go template file instead of a built-in template.
templatePath.tooltip: Overrides automatic template detection and the Template setting. Pick an existing file.

FileBrowser.Title: File browser
FileBrowser.intro: Pick a path on this machine.
FileBrowser.introFolderFile: Pick a folder. The file will be named {file}, but you can change the name after choosing.

tooltip.Go:
cd {path}
Change directory to the path in the box.

FileBrowser.CreateFolderIn: The folder will be created in: {path}
FileBrowser.InvalidPath: Invalid name. Do not include slashes (/ or \).
FileBrowser.FilterFilesDesc: Filter the list of displayed files. Folder pickers can create a new folder. To select a path that does not exist yet, type it into Path and click the green check.
